title: measuretwice case record (v0)
description: One record in a JSON Lines (JSONL) case dataset. Each nonempty line holds exactly one record. The dataset metadata file declares the dataset that contains these records. Reference labels never enter the input object.

group.description: Group of related cases. All cases of one group stay in one split. A record without a group forms its own group.

tags.description: Slice and failure-type labels. Evaluation reports group results by these tags.

input.description: Case input. Rust validates this object against the definition input schema before execution.

checks.description: Reference answers and expected outcomes, by check identifier.

expected.description: Reference labels and expected policy outcomes. Optional parts stay absent when unlabeled.

answer.description: Reference answer label, for a question with named answers.

level.description: Reference scale level, for an ordered question.

review.description: The reference is ambiguous. Humans must review the case.

outcome.description: Expected policy outcome for this check, where labeled.

author_type.description: Who produced the reference. A coding agent counts as a model author.

origin.description: Written for the dataset, or collected from real traffic.

reviewed.description: A human reviewed the reference after it was proposed.

reviewer.description: Reviewer attribution. Required when reviewed is true.

reason.description: Short statement of why the reference applies.

history.description: Earlier label records. Keep them when a correction replaces a reference.
